1.

2. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that sections of the Land Acquisition Act are wrongly mentioned in paragraph No. 3 of the order.

Instead of Section 34,
Section 28 is mentioned and vice versa.

Similarly, word "award" be replaced with "Collector's award".
3.
The error being inadvertent, it be corrected.
Corrected order be uploaded.

4. Motion stands disposed of.

sentences.text: PER COURT :
1. This motion is moved for speaking to the minutes.

2. It is contention of the learned Counsel for appellants that inadvertently in order dated 26/06/2024 the interest payable under Section 28 and 34 of the Act is not included in the operative part of the order.
Said error is inadvertently occurred, it is to be corrected.

3. It is held that the claimants are entitled for enhanced compensation and would be entitled to claim interest under Section 34 of the Land Acquisition Act @ 9% per annum from the date of Collector's award.
Similarly claimants would be entitled to get interest @ 9% per annum for first year under Section 28 of the Act and thereafter 15% per annum from the date of award till realization of the amount.
